title: gouldia macrocarpa var. cuneata
intro: Gouldia macrocarpa var. cuneata, commonly known as the 'cuneate gouldia', is a species of flowering plant in the family Cunoniaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, and has been traditionally used to treat various ailments such as wounds and infections. The therapeutic actions of Gouldia macrocarpa var. cuneata are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids and phenolic acids, which have been shown to exhibit antioxidant and free radical scavenging activities. However, more research is needed to fully understand the health benefits and bioactive constituents of this plant.
